items.t: Passenger airbag inflator can rupture (Takata recall)
Frame rust (frame replacement program)
items.job: Frame rust treatment or frame repair
items.note: Check with Toyota first; covered vehicles may still have program or settlement coverage.

items.t: ABS and VSC lights from a faulty yaw rate sensor
items.note: Wheel speed sensor faults cause similar lights and cost less.

items.t: Stability control can kick in at low speed (recall)
Side curtain airbags may deploy on their own (recall)
Seat heater wiring can short and burn (recall)
items.job: Install seat heater wiring protection or replace heater

items.t: Power steering gear can leak and lose assist (recall)
Sticking accelerator pedal (recall)
items.job: Install pedal reinforcement or replace pedal

items.t: Driver's power window switch can overheat (recall)
items.job: Grease or replace power window master switch

items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
Airbags may not deploy after a false fault (recall)
SUV can creep forward in Neutral (recall)
Backup camera image may not appear (recall)
Tow hitch cover can fall off (recall)
items.job: Replace hitch cover and modify bumper

items.t: Spare tire can drop from its carrier (recall)
Tires may have sidewall damage (recall)
Load capacity label may show the wrong weight (recall)
Front lower ball joint wear and separation (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front lower ball joints under recall
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer for trucks covered by the recall. Trucks outside the recall pay for the repair.

items.t: Cracked exhaust manifold
items.job: Replace one exhaust manifold and gaskets
items.note: Parts: Dorman stainless manifold about $216–$234 per side, genuine Toyota about $356–$397. Hours are based on YourMechanic (average $727 with $427 labor); its 2001 4.7L quote is about $1,930, and broken studs push labor to the high end.

items.t: Oxygen sensor heater failures
items.note: Based on YourMechanic, since no parts-plus-labor source was found: average $351 ($211 parts, $140 labor); its 2002 4.7L upstream sensor quote is about $791, which sets the high end for parts.

items.t: Secondary air injection pump or valve failure
items.job: Replace one secondary air injection pump
items.note: Parts: Toyota pump 17600-0F010 about $479 discounted ($699 list); owners report dealer pumps at $900–$1,200 each. Labor from YourMechanic's $95 average. Switching valves cost extra (one owner paid about $856 for both valves; another $3,341 for both pumps and valves). Ask Toyota about extended coverage first.

items.t: Front brakes wearing out early
items.job: Replace front brake pads (and rotors if worn)
items.note: Based on YourMechanic, since no parts-plus-labor source was found: pads average $80 parts and $146 labor, rotors add about $228 parts and $168 labor. YourMechanic quotes front pads on 2001/2007 4.7L at about $336; RepairPal lists $250–$365 for 2001–2007 pad jobs.

items.t: Leaking water pump
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant
items.note: Parts: aftermarket pumps about $68–$155, genuine Toyota 16100-09491 about $143–$207. Go-Parts lists about 3.5 hours. RepairPal: $723–$914 total for most 2008–2022 years.
